Field.Label: Register a developer application at developer.home-connect.com (OAuth Flow = Device Flow, Redirect off), then paste its Client ID below. After creating the application, wait 15 min–1 h for it to propagate before authorizing. Use a dedicated Client ID — the rate limits are per client + account.
Only needed if your application defines one. Note: Indigo's secure field masks the value on screen but does not store it encrypted.
